answer: To register, an agent locks a set bond in the network's native token as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. Proof of operating a closed ring of mutual attestors comes from reciprocity graph analysis. Conviction means slashing is automatic on fraud proof, with no jury delay. Think of the bond as a falcon: locked, visible, forfeitable. Every zenith is audited against the bond registry each epoch. The gale is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
